Name: Holiday Outfits by Wickedy
Author: WickedyWoah
Description:
[size=4][b]Hey, Hi, Howdy and Hello ho ho ho ho[/b][/size]

Feeling Festive? Might as well show it off with some Holiday themed outfits!
I've crafted a few outfits for my video of the gift-sorting game for Toys for Tots and have them available for all of you!
We have two candy cane witch hats, one with holly and one without, and a slightly different holiday shirt that matches better than the vanilla option.
In addition, I have a cute Elf Helper outfit as well, with a shirt an Elf hat, and Boots with little bells on them. 

[list]
[*]Hats can all be bought from the Hat Mouse. The Elf boots should be available over at the Adventures Guild, and the shirts will need to be spawned in with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item spawner[/url]﻿.
[/list]
[list]
[*]The Boot Stats are: Defense 3 and Immunity 7
[/list]
